opportunities.title: Atari 5200: AtariMax flash cartridges unsupported (Bounty Bob done in #1190)
opportunities.summary: `crates/machine-atari-5200/src/cartridge.rs:3` declares "no bank switching" and `Cartridge::from_rom` (`cartridge.rs:27-33`) rejects any size outside 4/8/16/32 KB. The 5200 has two real bank-switched cartridge families that therefore cannot load at all: - **Bounty Bob Strikes Back** — 40 KB, two switchable 4 KB windows at `$4000`/`$5000`, selected by accesses to `$4FF6-$4FF9` / `$5FF6-$5FF9`. - **AtariMax** 128 KB / 512 KB flash carts (bank-switch register semantics need reference confirmation — see runtime-verification notes). Implement a cartridge mapper that supports these layouts. The switch needs a hook in `mem_read`/`mem_write` (`lib.rs:264,397`), where `cart.read` is currently side-effect-free. Drive the mapper from the `.car`/`.a52` cart-type byte (see the header-stripping issue) where present, falling back to size detection. Without this, Bounty Bob and the AtariMax library are unrunnable. Confirm exact AtariMax bank registers against MAME/Altirra before implementing.

opportunities.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 187200`. ### Notes The `d` character is already accepted by the token regex, so malformed-input detection still passes — the value is just never added. A fix should add the `d` unit and cover it with tests. /bounty $50
